questions.stem: A junior radiologist performing a fetal doppler follows the direction of the flow of oxygenated blood from the placenta to the fetus to examine the fetal circulatory vessels. The sequence that he would follow is:
questions.stemHtml: A junior radiologist performing a fetal doppler follows the direction of the flow of oxygenated blood from the placenta to the fetus to examine the fetal circulatory vessels. The sequence that he would follow is:

options.label: A
options.text: Umbilical artery → inferior vena cava → ductus venosus → right atrium → left atrium

options.label: B
options.text: Umbilical artery → superior vena cava → right atrium → ductus arteriosus → left atrium

options.label: C
options.text: Umbilical vein → ductus venosus → inferior vena cava → right atrium → left atrium

options.label: D
options.text: Umbilical vein → ductus arteriosus → superior vena cava → right atrium → left atrium
